title: एकविंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Restored to heaven, Yayati asks Brahma why his vast merit was so soon exhausted, and is told that it was destroyed by his pride. Narada ends the tale, warning Duryodhana that obstinacy and pride bring ruin, like Galava's insistence and Yayati's arrogance.
summary.kn: ಸ್ವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳಿದ ಯಯಾತಿ ತನ್ನ ಅಪಾರ ಪುಣ್ಯ ಇಷ್ಟು ಬೇಗ ಏಕೆ ಕ್ಷೀಣಿಸಿತು ಎಂದು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ ಗರ್ವದಿಂದ ನಾಶವಾಯಿತು ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಗಾಲವನ ಹಠ ಮತ್ತು ಯಯಾತಿಯ ಗರ್ವದಂತೆ ಹಠ ಮತ್ತು ಅಹಂಕಾರ ವಿನಾಶ ತರುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನನ್ನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸಿ ನಾರದರು ಕಥೆ ಮುಗಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: स्वर्ग में पुनः स्थापित ययाति ब्रह्मा से पूछते हैं कि उनका विशाल पुण्य इतनी शीघ्र क्यों क्षीण हुआ, और उन्हें बताया जाता है कि उनके अहंकार ने उसे नष्ट किया। नारद कथा समाप्त कर दुर्योधन को चेताते हैं कि गालव के हठ और ययाति के अहंकार की तरह हठ और अभिमान विनाश लाते हैं।
summary.te: స్వర్గంలో తిరిగి నిలిచిన యయాతి తన అపార పుణ్యం ఇంత త్వరగా ఎందుకు క్షీణించిందని బ్రహ్మను అడగగా గర్వం వల్ల నశించిందని తెలుసుకుంటాడు. గాలవుని మొండితనం, యయాతి గర్వం లాగే మొండితనం, అహంకారం వినాశాన్ని తెస్తాయని దుర్యోధనుని హెచ్చరించి నారదుడు కథ ముగిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: ஸ்வர்க்கத்தில் மீண்டும் நிலைபெற்ற யயாதி தன் அளவற்ற புண்ணியம் ஏன் இவ்வளவு விரைவில் தீர்ந்தது என்று ப்ரஹ்மாவிடம் கேட்க, அவன் செருக்கே அதை அழித்தது என்று அறிகிறான். காலவனின் பிடிவாதமும் யயாதியின் செருக்கும் போலப் பிடிவாதமும் அகந்தையும் அழிவைக் கொணரும் என்று துரியோதனனை எச்சரித்து நாரதர் கதையை முடிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ തിരിച്ചെത്തിയ യയാതി, തന്റെ വലിയ പുണ്യം ഇത്ര വേഗം തീർന്നതെന്തുകൊണ്ടെന്ന് ബ്രഹ്മാവിനോട് ചോദിക്കുന്നു; അഹങ്കാരമാണ് അത് നശിപ്പിച്ചതെന്ന് മറുപടി ലഭിക്കുന്നു. ഗാലവന്റെ ദുശ്ശാഠ്യവും യയാതിയുടെ അഹങ്കാരവും പോലെ, ദുശ്ശാഠ്യവും അഹങ്കാരവും നാശത്തിലേക്ക് നയിക്കുമെന്ന് ദുര്യോധനന് മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് നൽകിക്കൊണ്ട് നാരദൻ കഥ അവസാനിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.121; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
सद्भिरारोपितः स्वर्गं पार्थिवैर्भूरिदक्षिणैः ।
अभ्यनुज्ञाय दौहित्रान्ययातिर्दिवमास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Raised to heaven by those good kings, givers of rich fees, Yayati took leave of his daughter's sons and took his place in heaven.

verses.text:
अभिवृष्टश्च वर्षेण नानापुष्पसुगन्धिना ।
परिष्वक्तश्च पुण्येन वायुना पुण्यगन्धिना ॥

meaning.en: A rain of fragrant flowers fell on him, and he was embraced by a holy, sweet-scented wind.

verses.text:
अचलं स्थानमारुह्य दौहित्रफलनिर्जितम् ।
कर्मभिः स्वैरुपचितो जज्वाल परया श्रिया ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the unmoving place won by the fruit of his grandsons, enriched by his own deeds, he blazed with supreme glory.

verses.text:
उपगीतोपनृत्तश्च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणैः ।
प्रीत्या प्रतिगृहीतश्च स्वर्गे दुन्दुभिनिस्वनैः ॥

meaning.en: Gandharvas and apsarases sang and danced for him, and he was received lovingly in heaven with the sound of drums.

verses.text:
अभिष्टुतश्च विविधैर्देवराजर्षिचारणैः ।
अर्चितश्चोत्तमार्घेण दैवतैरभिनन्दितः ॥

meaning.en: He was praised by gods, royal sages and charanas of many kinds, worshipped with the best honors and welcomed by the deities.

verses.text:
प्राप्तः स्वर्गफलं चैव तमुवाच पितामहः ।
निर्वृतं शान्तमनसं वचोभिस्तर्पयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: When he had attained the fruit of heaven, the grandfather Brahma spoke to him, content and calm of mind, as if gladdening him with his words.

verses.text:
चतुष्पादस्त्वया धर्मश्चितो लोक्येन कर्मणा ।
अक्षयस्तव लोकोऽयं कीर्तिश्चैवाक्षया दिवि ।
पुनस्तवाद्य राजर्षे सुकृतेनेह कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: 'By your worldly deeds you built up the four-footed Dharma. This world of yours is imperishable, royal sage, and your fame in heaven is imperishable, and today it is yours again by your good deed here.

verses.text:
आवृतं तमसा चेतः सर्वेषां स्वर्गवासिनाम् ।
येन त्वां नाभिजानन्ति ततोऽज्ञात्वासि पातितः ॥

meaning.en: The minds of all the dwellers of heaven were veiled in darkness, so they did not recognize you; for that reason you, unrecognized, were thrown down.

verses.text:
प्रीत्यैव चासि दौहित्रैस्तारितस्त्वमिहागतः ।
स्थानं च प्रतिपन्नोऽसि कर्मणा स्वेन निर्जितम् ।
अचलं शाश्वतं पुण्यमुत्तमं ध्रुवमव्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: You have come here saved by your daughter's sons out of love, and you have gained a place won by your own deeds, unmoving, eternal, holy, supreme, fixed and imperishable.'

verses.text: ययातिरुवाच

meaning.en: Yayati said:

verses.text:
भगवन्संशयो मेऽस्ति कश्चित्तं छेत्तुमर्हसि ।
न ह्यन्यमहमर्हामि प्रष्टुं लोकपितामह ॥

meaning.en: 'Lord, I have a doubt; you should cut it. Grandfather of the world, I cannot ask anyone else.

verses.text:
बहुवर्षसहस्रान्तं प्रजापालनवर्धितम् ।
अनेकक्रतुदानौघैरर्जितं मे महत्फलम् ॥

meaning.en: The great fruit I earned, built up over many thousands of years by protecting my subjects and by many floods of sacrifices and gifts,

verses.text:
कथं तदल्पकालेन क्षीणं येनास्मि पातितः ।
भगवन्वेत्थ लोकांश्च शाश्वतान्मम निर्जितान् ॥

meaning.en: how was it exhausted in so short a time that I was thrown down? Lord, you know the eternal worlds I have won.'

verses.text: पितामह उवाच

meaning.en: The Grandfather said:

verses.text:
बहुवर्षसहस्रान्तं प्रजापालनवर्धितम् ।
अनेकक्रतुदानौघैर्यत्त्वयोपार्जितं फलम् ॥

meaning.en: 'The fruit you had gained over many thousands of years by protecting your subjects and by floods of sacrifices and gifts,

verses.text:
तदनेनैव दोषेण क्षीणं येनासि पातितः ।
अभिमानेन राजेन्द्र धिक्कृतः स्वर्गवासिभिः ॥

meaning.en: was spent by this one fault for which you were cast down: pride, king, for which the dwellers of heaven reproached you.

verses.text:
नायं मानेन राजर्षे न बलेन न हिंसया ।
न शाठ्येन न मायाभिर्लोको भवति शाश्वतः ॥

meaning.en: This world does not become eternal by pride, royal sage, nor by strength, nor by violence, nor by deceit, nor by trickery.

verses.text:
नावमान्यास्त्वया राजन्नवरोत्कृष्टमध्यमाः ।
न हि मानप्रदग्धानां कश्चिदस्ति समः क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: You should not despise the low, the high or the middling, king; for no one is ever the equal of those burnt up by pride.

verses.text:
पतनारोहणमिदं कथयिष्यन्ति ये नराः ।
विषमाण्यपि ते प्राप्तास्तरिष्यन्ति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Those who relate this account of the fall and the rise will cross even difficult places; there is no doubt.'

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
एष दोषोऽभिमानेन पुरा प्राप्तो ययातिना ।
निर्बन्धतश्चातिमात्रं गालवेन महीपते ॥

meaning.en: This fault Yayati incurred in the past through pride, and Galava through excessive obstinacy, king.

verses.text:
श्रोतव्यं हितकामानां सुहृदां भूतिमिच्छताम् ।
न कर्तव्यो हि निर्बन्धो निर्बन्धो हि क्षयोदयः ॥

meaning.en: Those who desire their own good and wish prosperity should heed the counsel of well-wishing friends; for one should not be obstinate, since obstinacy leads to ruin.

verses.text:
तस्मात्त्वमपि गान्धारे मानं क्रोधं च वर्जय ।
संधत्स्व पाण्डवैर्वीर संरम्भं त्यज पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: So you too, son of Gandhari, give up pride and anger. Make peace with the Pandavas, hero, and abandon your fury, king.

verses.text:
ददाति यत्पार्थिव यत्करोति
यद्वा तपस्तप्यति यज्जुहोति ।
न तस्य नाशोऽस्ति न चापकर्षो
नान्यस्तदश्नाति स एव कर्ता ॥

meaning.en: Whatever a man gives, does, practices in austerity or offers in sacrifice, of that there is no destruction or diminution; no one else eats it, only the doer himself.

verses.text:
इदं महाख्यानमनुत्तमं मतं
बहुश्रुतानां गतरोषरागिणाम् ।
समीक्ष्य लोके बहुधा प्रधाविता
त्रिवर्गदृष्टिः पृथिवीमुपाश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: This great story is considered unsurpassed by the learned who are free of anger and attachment. Having considered it in the world in many ways, one who looks to the three aims of life obtains the earth.
